lessons.title: Components – Building Blocks of Behavior
lessons.description: Learn what components are, how to add/remove them, and explore the most common built‑in components.

lessons.title: Mesh Renderer & Mesh Filter
lessons.description: Understand how 3D objects get their shape (Mesh Filter) and appearance (Mesh Renderer).

lessons.title: Colliders & Rigidbody Basics
lessons.description: Add physical boundaries with colliders and bring your objects to life with Rigidbody physics.

lessons.title: Introduction to Materials
lessons.description: Create materials, assign colors, and understand the role of shaders in rendering.

lessons.title: Textures & Material Maps
lessons.description: Apply images to materials, explore albedo maps, normal maps, and tiling.

lessons.title: Shaders & the Rendering Pipeline
lessons.description: Discover how shaders control the final look of your objects and get a peek into the rendering flow.
